question: Who signed the MoU with the Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT) for the development of "Wideband Spectrum-Sensor ASIC-Chip"?

options.text: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi and IIT Roorkee
Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Mandi and IIT Jammu
Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras and IIT Hyderabad
Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kanpur and IIT Kharagpur

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Mandi and IIT Jammu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT) signed an agreement with **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Mandi** and **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jammu**.
 
• The agreement focuses on developing a "Wideband Spectrum-Sensor ASIC-Chip for Enhancing Spectrum Utilization."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The MoU was signed under the **Telecom Technology Development Fund (TTDF)** scheme by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT).
 
• This project aims to develop a wideband spectrum sensing algorithm and hardware to improve spectrum utilization efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• About C-DOT:__

 __
 
• It is the premier Telecom R&D centre of the Department of Telecommunications, Government of India.
 
• Focuses on developing state-of-the-art telecommunication solutions.
 
 
 
• Telecom Technology Development Fund (TTDF):__
 
 
• Designed to fund Indian startups, academia, and R&D institutions.
 
• Aims to enable affordable broadband and mobile services across India.
